svg.text: cap; a final report, not a stop
types, a tool name with one
the same call a third time
with no edit between, or a
a write that hides code behind
writes run one at a time
each file line is sent once;
import and test the top hits
it said it would act but did
The guards, and where each one acts
Switch one off with --off <name>, /harness off <name>, or the eval variant full-<name>.
Green: on by default. Yellow: on only in some cases. Violet: opt-in. Whether a guard helps is measured with amness eval --variants ablate (see 07).
